title: An owned question is settled when the architect holds what it needs, in any turn
situation: Live, asked only for an update, the architect often settles an open meaning question it owns and reports it settled; a judge then failed workflow 23 for replacing the unresolved condition and giving no recommended action. The lead proposed that an update only reports, leaving an owned question open with the architect's intended ruling until a request or the work needs it.
decision: No to deferral. The architect settles a meaning question it owns as soon as it holds what it needs to, in whatever turn it arises, an update included, and reports it settled with its reason; deferring a decision it could take is procedure past its objective, and holding it open for the operator is a hand-back. It leaves open only a question that needs something it does not hold, and reports the one action it is taking to get it. In the rubrics of workflow 23 and agents 18, a decision taken in the turn and reported with its reason is that topic's outcome and action; reporting it settled never counts as replacing an unresolved condition. No example text changes.
consequences: The rubric judges are told this reading; the launched architect is told to decide on sight what it holds, never to defer it.
